name: The Golden Myth
source:
You're a prince, and he's a creature thought extinct. Your secret bond could save the kingdom... or doom it. Will you choose love over duty?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你是一国王子，而他则是世人以为早已灭绝的异族生灵。你们之间隐秘的羁绊既可能拯救王国……也可能令其万劫不复。在责任面前，你会选择爱情吗？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
